newsitem.title: CHINA: Hong Kong stocks seen trending in narrow range.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks seen trending in narrow range.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks are expected to trade in a relatively narrow range on Wednesday, although brokers said the market's key property sector could attract more interest and give the index a small boost.
"We've had a good run-up on major news and we could take a short breather today," said a broker with a large British house. "Investment property stocks could attract some interest."
Overnight, the Hang Seng London Reference Index shed 7.23 points, or 0.04 percent, to close at 16,364.29.
Brokers said they were not concerned about the trend reversal in the U.S. long bond, which closed in New York on Tuesday 6/32 lower at 101-23/32 to yield 6.49 percent.
"There is still not enough evidence for the Fed to want to put up rates," said Jason Tang in institutional sales at South China Securities.
Stronger-than-expected U.S. economic data had led many U.S. economists to forecast a slight rise in interest rates at the U.S. Federal Reserve meeting on August 19.
The Dow Industrial slipped 10.91 points close at 8,187.54 in mixed rotational trading, brokers said.
